name: diocle
description: Check that a COBOL file compiles under GnuCOBOL, then convert and verify it with Diocle, using your own Meta key on your machine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Diocle compiles and runs code from the workspace (GnuCOBOL and the generated Java) to verify it, so it only works in a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Diocle: Check that this COBOL compiles
Diocle: Convert and verify this COBOL file

diocle.converterPython.markdownDescription: Path to a Python that has `diocle_converter` installed. Empty: `services/converter/.venv` in the workspace if it exists, else `python3`.

diocle.maxUsd.markdownDescription: Hard dollar cap for one conversion (your own Meta key). The converter refuses the next model call that could pass it. Maximum 1.00.

diocle.convertAnyway.markdownDescription: Also try programs Diocle would normally refuse, and repair a file that does not compile. Results are labelled: a repaired or unverified result is never shown as certified.

diocle.copybookPaths.markdownDescription: Folders searched for COPY members (relative to the workspace folder or absolute). The folder of the COBOL file is always searched.

diocle.confirmCost.markdownDescription: Ask before each conversion, stating the cap and where the code goes.
